import pyref, random
bad=0
for seed in range(300):
    rng=random.Random(seed)
    n=rng.randint(1,120)
    seen={}
    while len(seen)<n:
        hi=rng.getrandbits(64); lo=rng.getrandbits(64); l=rng.randint(0,128)
        hi,lo=pyref.norm(hi,lo,l)
        seen[(hi,lo,l)]=rng.randint(0,4194302)
    pre=sorted([(h,l,ln,hop) for (h,l,ln),hop in seen.items()])
    img=pyref.build_image(pre, rng)
    try:
        got=pyref.validate(img)
        assert got==seen, (seed,'set mismatch')
    except AssertionError as e:
        print('ASSERT',e); bad+=1
    except Exception as e:
        print('seed',seed,'err',repr(e)); bad+=1
        raise SystemExit
print('pyref self consistent, bad=',bad)
